retractedEarlierFinding.explanation: The delivered payload carries startMs/endMs on each transcript ITEM, not on a nested segments array. The earlier checker looked only at the nested shape and therefore read zero. Re-measured against the real shape, 23 and 25 expose 20 of 20 offsets over the live API and all 4 published artifacts validate.

endpointSweep.falsePositivesRetracted: An earlier sweep reported 12 404s across /toeic/exam-sets, /market/items and two arena status paths. All four were paths this audit invented; the real routes are /toeic/exams, /market/products and the /arena socket namespace, and each returns 200 or its proper socket event. /courses/my-enrollments returned 400 for the same reason: the real route is /courses/:courseId/my-enrollments.

browserAudit.dynamicRouteCompression: One representative id per dynamic family, chosen from live published data, because each family is one page component with one contract, one authorization model and one interaction model. Families compressed: /courses/:id, /flashcard/:id, /listening/:id, /speaking/:id, /reading/:id, /writing/:id, /exams/:id (all three TOEIC products audited individually since their adapters differ).
browserAudit.notBrowserAudited: Runtime/attempt and submission-detail routes (/toeic/attempts/:id, /toeic/results/:id, /toeic/review/:id, /*/submissions/:id, /my-courses/:courseId/lessons/:lessonId, /classes/:classId, /diagnostic deep flow) were not driven end-to-end in this pass: they need committed learner submissions or paid external grading, which the audit-only rule excludes. TOEIC attempt creation and the assessment runtime were exercised in the preceding routing phase.

responsive.falsePositivesInvestigated: 7 controls were first flagged as offscreen on /exams, /market, /arena, /listening/1. Each was shown to sit inside a horizontally-scrollable strip (certificate carousel, category strip, tier strip), so they are reachable by swiping and are not unreachable CTAs.

samePageScroll.detail: /speaking, /market, /exams reset with document height unchanged; /reading, /listening reset below their remaining maxScroll; /reading?category= is a genuine navigation governed by the global scroll-to-top policy.
